headline: Man killed in Brahmanbaria during village mediation over marital dispute
summary: Jahangir Alam, a local political leader, died after being attacked with locally made weapons during an arbitration meeting to settle his niece's marital conflict. Several others were injured in the incident.
details: Jahangir Alam, a local leader of the Jatiyatabadi Sramik Dal, was killed and several others injured in an attack following a dispute during a village arbitration meeting in Brahmanbaria's Sadar upazila on Monday evening.

The deceased, Jahangir Alam, 50, was a resident of Sultanpur Uttarpara. The meeting was convened to settle a marital conflict between his niece and her husband, Md Ataullah, who had reportedly been experiencing disputes for five years.

During the discussions, an argument broke out between Jahangir and members of Ataullah's family. Relatives and supporters of Ataullah allegedly attacked members of his wife's family with locally made weapons, leaving Jahangir and several others injured.

Locals rescued the injured and took them to Brahmanbaria General Hospital, where doctors declared Jahangir dead. Police later visited the scene and Jahangir’s body has been kept at the hospital morgue for autopsy.
Md Rakib Ur Reza, additional superintendent of police (Sadar Circle), stated that authorities are actively working to bring those involved in the incident under the law.
